integrity: Original automorphism-group results and standard finite-field norm-similitude counts are attributed; the stated contribution concerns singular endomorphisms and von Neumann regularity. Direct finite enumeration supplements but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The anisotropic family is restricted to odd finite fields with -lambda nonsquare. The result is only a two-family rank, idempotent and regularity census; priority over all literature and independent external validation are not established.
title: Singular endomorphism and regularity dichotomy in two three-dimensional Leibniz algebras
